learnings: git mv of a directory fails with 'No such file or directory' if the destination parent directory does not exist — mkdir -p the parent first
git stores symlinks as mode 120000 blobs containing the target path; GitHub renders them as text files showing the relative target, and re-creates real symlinks on clone (macOS/Linux)
